wheel_diameter_m.source: M1.T9 measurements.csv W1_tyre_diameter_direct (direct unloaded tyre diameter; NOT a roll-out)

imu_z_m.source: M1.T9 (derived): measurements.csv S1_imu_board_top_h (board top above the floor) - wheel_diameter_m / 2 = board top above the axle midpoint

corners.source: M1.T9 (derived): plan-view extreme points from the axle midpoint (derived.txt); the ESP32-CAM front corners and the plate-front corners ASSUME those parts are centred on y = 0 (only their widths were measured)

sweep_radius_m.source: M1.T9 (derived): the largest distance over corners, reached at the caster swung fully forward, which uses no centring assumption

measured.by: Xiaohui Chen (readings); the plate-outline rows with instrument 'CAD ...' are a classmate's CAD model
instruments: ruler / tape measure in mm (the CSV names a ruler for rows B9 and B10; the other length rows, including the 2026-10-29 B15 power-bank rows, say 'not stated')
two Pitney Bowes kitchen scales, 5 kg x 1 g (rows K1_total_mass, K2_caster_load, K2_drive_wheels_load, 2026-10-10)
Pitney Bowes postal scale, 5 kg x 1 g (row K1_total_mass_remeasure, 2026-10-29, M1.T16)
two Pitney Bowes postal scales of that model, side by side (rows K2_caster_load_remeasure, K2_drive_wheels_load_remeasure, 2026-10-29, M1.T16)

CAD: a classmate's Onshape model and drawing of the Emo chassis plate (STEP file and DRW_MOBILE_ROBOT_CHASSIS.pdf, 2026-10-13; the private course repo (plate CAD is not published here)), rows whose instrument starts 'CAD'
measured.notes: Readings by Xiaohui Chen on 2026-10-10, taken for the Module 6 lab (assignments/assignment6/measurements.csv, reviewed in assignments/assignment6/review/MEASUREMENT-REVIEW.md) and copied unchanged to evidence/M1/M1.T9/measurements-xiaohui-chen-2026-10-10.csv. UPDATE 2026-10-16: car.json is now built from evidence/M1/M1.T9/measurements-2026-10-16-with-plate-cad.csv, which is that copy plus superseding rows for the plate outline from a classmate's CAD of the same Emo chassis plate (instrument 'CAD ...': width 147.92 mm, narrow strip 100 mm, wing depth 34.35 mm, front arc R135.14 mm, front corner fillets R8 mm) and B1/B2/B4 fitted to the CAD plate length 206.98 mm (130.49 / 76.49 / 76.49 mm; instrument 'fit ...'). The wheel, track, caster, camera, IMU, height and mass readings are unchanged: the CAD models the plate only. UPDATE 2026-10-29: car.json is now built from evidence/M1/M1.T9/measurements-2026-10-29-with-m1t16-mass.csv, which is the 2026-10-16 file unchanged plus Xiaohui Chen's 2026-10-29 readings of the car as it is now (M1.T16, evidence/M1/M1.T16/measurements.md): K1_total_mass_remeasure = 660 g on one Pitney Bowes postal scale (5 kg x 1 g), in the staying configuration (as measurements.md says; the M1.T16 prerequisites in plan/M1-foundations.md define it as bank fixed, four cells in, camera on, only the cables that stay on the car; the battery switch state was not recorded), and the two-scale split K2_caster_load_remeasure 58 g + K2_drive_wheels_load_remeasure 602 g = 660 g. The caster was NOT turned sideways on its scale this time (it was on 2026-10-10) and which way it trailed is unknown. Xiaohui's decision: use the middle value, 0.0105 +- 0.0018 m ahead of the axle; the URDF implements it with the swivel x (C3, 120 mm) as the lever arm (car_geometry_extras.xacro; the +- 0.0018 m assumes the 20 mm trail of the 2026-10-10 notes, and the readings alone give 0.0088 to 0.0112 m). The power bank (70 x 70 x 25 mm, rows B15_bank_*) and the cables are now on the car; the URDF draws the bank as geometry only. In car.json only mass_kg changed (0.506 -> 0.660 kg, uncertainty unchanged at 0.0014 kg). The footprint keys (front_overhang_m, rear_overhang_m, chassis_length_m, corners, sweep_radius_m) and chassis_height_m are deliberately NOT updated: the bank's rear face (85 mm behind the axle) is 8.5 mm behind the plate's rear apex, the Pico's USB cable reaches 148 mm behind the axle (outside the 0.140 m sweep radius; row X1_pico_usb_cable_rear_x, not a model input), and the front-most point of the camera's cable is not measured yet; Xiaohui decides the footprint later. Ride height, camera stand, BNO055, antenna, tyres and cell type are unchanged (Xiaohui, evidence/M1/M1.T16/confirm.md). Car on the floor, battery off, camera fitted, no USB cable (the 2026-10-10 readings; for the 2026-10-29 weighing see UPDATE 2026-10-29). DEVIATIONS from the M1.T9 procedure, each for Xiaohui to accept or redo: (1) ONE reading per quantity, not three, so there is no repeatability check; uncertainty = 2 mm per ruler reading, 5 mm for readings given as 'around', 1 g per scale reading, with these exceptions: at least 3 mm for every x measured from the axle line, because the axle line itself is located to about 3 mm (review #15; rows B1, B2, B3, B4 and S1_imu_board_centre_x get 3 mm, while the 'around' rows C2, C2b and S3_lens_x keep 5 mm), 4 mm for the 2026-10-10 B5b reading (review #7; that reading is superseded since 2026-10-16), 0.5 mm for a CAD dimension (an allowance, not a measured tolerance), and root-sum-square of 1 g and 1 g for the two-scale mass; propagated root-sum-square into derived values. (2) NO 5-revolution roll-out: wheel_diameter_m is the direct, unloaded tyre diameter (row W1_tyre_diameter_direct), not the effective rolling diameter under load; rollout_left_m, rollout_right_m, wheel_diameter_left_m and wheel_diameter_right_m are omitted. (3) Encoder counts per wheel revolution postponed (they need the Pico): counts_per_rev_left, counts_per_rev_right and ticks_per_wheel_rev are omitted. (4) front_overhang_m was measured with NO USB cable in the ESP32-CAM; re-measure with the operating cable (M3.T1). The camera is now powered from the power bank and its cable sticks out at the front (evidence/M1/M1.T16/confirm.md); its front-most point is not measured yet (M1.T16, 2026-10-29). (5) imu_axes not recorded (no photo of the BNO055's printed axes). (6) The camera is not calibrated (M1.T7): lens_x_m, lens_y_m and lens_z_m are ruler readings of the lens position. (7) chassis_length_m, chassis_width_m and chassis_height_m are NOT the whole-car bounding box that M1.T9 step 3 asks for. They describe the main body without the drive wheels and without the camera stand, which is what the URDF chassis box (M2.T4 step 5, body_width) draws and what M2.T3 maps to body_width_m (kinsim's contact corners): length = front_overhang_m + rear_overhang_m = 0.214 m (0.21449 m since 2026-10-16; 0.215 m before) (also the whole car's length, except that the caster swung fully forward reaches x = 0.140 m, see corners); width = the widest plate point, the rear wing, 0.148 m (CAD 147.92 mm since 2026-10-16; the 150 mm ruler reading before) (the whole car is 0.160 m wide over the tyres = track_outer_m); height = gearbox bottoms (30 mm above the floor) to battery-holder top (66 mm) = 0.036 m (since 2026-10-29 the power bank's bottom, 17 mm above the floor, is the lowest body point; chassis_height_m is deliberately left at 0.036 m) (the whole car reaches about 0.100 m above the floor at the camera-stand top, row B10_camera_stand_top_h, 'around 10 cm'). (8) corners, and therefore sweep_radius_m, rest on one ASSUMPTION: the ESP32-CAM front corners and the plate-front corners take y = +-(measured width) / 2, i.e. those parts are assumed centred on y = 0 (their sideways offsets were not measured). Until 2026-10-16 the farthest corner, which set sweep_radius_m = 0.140218 m, was a square plate-front corner (0.131, +-0.050). Since 2026-10-16 the plate-front corners follow the CAD's rounded front (an R135.14 arc with R8 corner fillets, apex at B1): (0.1229, +-0.0447) m, r = 0.1308 m; the farthest point is now the caster swung fully forward (0.140, 0), so sweep_radius_m = 0.140 m needs no centring assumption. The stick antenna was not measured (review #9). CONVENTIONS: x and y from the axle midpoint, +x toward the camera/caster end, +y to the robot's left. lens_z_m (lens centre) is a height above the FLOOR, as M1.T9 step 3 ('measure as M1.T7 step 8') and M1.T7 step 8 define the camera's z_m. imu_z_m is the BNO055 board top surface above the AXLE midpoint, as M1.T9 step 3 defines the IMU position ('from the axle midpoint'): row S1_imu_board_top_h (60 mm above the floor) minus wheel_diameter_m / 2 (33.5 mm) = 0.0265 m, uncertainty root-sum-square of 2 mm and 1 mm = 0.0022 m. The URDF's base_link is at axle height, wheel_diameter_m / 2 above the floor. caster_x_m is the trailing caster's floor contact ('around'); the swivel pivot is at about 0.120 m (row C3) and the swung-forward wheel front at about 0.140 m (row C2b), which conflicts with a 20 mm swivel offset (review #4, open). mass_kg: whole car in the staying configuration (M1.T16 prerequisites: bank fixed, four cells in, camera on, only the cables that stay on the car) = 660 g on one postal scale = 58 g on the caster + 602 g on the drive wheels (2026-10-29, row K1_total_mass_remeasure; until 2026-10-29: 0.506 kg, the car with batteries and camera, no power bank, no cable, = 142 g on the caster + 364 g on the drive wheels).
